confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'restricted airflow will eventually cause the compressor to overwork and fail prematurely' and 'the tight 1cm gaps are trapping heat and causing the sides to overheat' - presented as fault when side warmth is normal condenser behaviour

blockingLoop.evidence: Kept asking irrelevant checks (freezer coil ice, door switch/fan, vents, door seals, hinges) despite cooling at 4C/-18C and customer saying they don't apply; also asked about burning smell again after it was answered

rationale: The assistant correctly said early on that it is not typically a fire risk, but it then wrongly framed normal side-wall condenser warmth as overheating and predicted compressor failure. It ignored evidence (cooling fine, no smell, no visible coils, refusal to pull the unit out), pushed irrelevant not-cooling checks such as seals, hinges and ice, and repeated the burning-smell question already answered. It never clearly reassured the customer that warm sides are normal, never pointed to the manual's clearance figures, and gave inconsistent clearance numbers (2-5cm, then 5cm).
